Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  020 = 0 * 20
  111 = 1 * 11
  211 = 2 * 11
  0122 = 01 * 22
  1000 = 10 * 00
  2021 = 20 * 21
  11110 = 111 * 10
  11121 = 111 * 21
  20020 = 20 * 020
  21211 = 21 * 211
  22020 = 22 * 020
  012221211 = 0122 * 21211
  111212021 = 11121 * 2021
